name: @w6w-apps/savvycal
description: Manage SavvyCal scheduling links, book and cancel events, read availability, and register webhooks, plus webhook triggers for event, attendee and poll-response changes (and an Any Event trigger) and polls for new links, workflows and workflow rules.

w6w.longDescription:
SavvyCal is a scheduling tool: people book time through your scheduling links. This app drives the SavvyCal Meetings API (api.savvycal.com/v1) from a workflow.

It can list and read booked events, create an event on a link at an available slot, and cancel one; create, update, duplicate, toggle and delete scheduling links (personal or under a team scope); read a link's open time slots so a workflow can pick a real one before booking; and look up the signed-in user, time zones, and workflow rules.

It also registers and removes SavvyCal webhooks, so a workflow can be told when an event is created, rescheduled or canceled instead of polling. Connect with a personal access token for your own account, or with OAuth when acting on behalf of other users. Health checks track SavvyCal's Instatus status page.

Triggers start a workflow when an event is created, requested, approved, declined, changed, canceled, rescheduled or paid, when an attendee is added or cancels, when a poll response arrives (or on any other delivery type you list), and when a new link, workflow or workflow rule appears. Each registers its own SavvyCal webhook through the API and verifies every delivery's HMAC-SHA256 signature before anything runs.
